stories.title: SCRUM-93 — User Story 1, Deploy to Production (https://streetcarnola.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-93)

tasks.title: Containerize the backend for Render
tasks.description: Dockerfile for the Spring Boot backend, bind 0.0.0.0 and read Render's PORT; runs in a container locally, local dev unchanged, ./mvnw verify green.

tasks.title: Create the Render web service on Supabase
tasks.description: Render web service with Supabase and JWT env vars set in Render; schema.sql creates the tables in Supabase and a live sign-in plus submission write persists; no secrets committed.

tasks.title: Read allowed CORS origins from configuration
tasks.description: CorsConfig reads ALLOWED_ORIGINS (localhost by default) so the deployed frontend is allowed and other origins are refused; covered by a test.

tasks.title: Lock down the demo reset on the live app
tasks.description: POST /auth/reset requires a signed-in user (401 without a token) and no longer deletes accounts, so new sign-ups and their submissions survive a reset and stay visible to advisors; tests cover both.

tasks.title: Deploy the frontend pointed at the live backend
tasks.description: React build hosted with VITE_API_URL set to the Render URL and an SPA rewrite; sign-in calls the live backend and deep links like /student load directly.

tasks.title: Show when the app is on fixture data or waking the server
tasks.description: A visible notice when the app falls back to sample data and a waking-the-server state during Render cold starts; Vitest render and interaction tests pass.

tasks.title: Deploy automatically from GitHub Actions after the tests pass
tasks.description: Deploy jobs in ci.yml call the Render and frontend deploy hooks only after every test job passes on a push to main; branches and PRs never deploy.

tasks.title: Verify the semester requirements on the live app and document the deployment
tasks.description: Full CRUD and both roles checked on the live app, JaCoCo service coverage still 70%+, README and DEMO.md link the live app and describe the deployment.

tasks.title: Update the class, package and sequence diagrams
tasks.description: Diagrams in docs/ updated for User, JPA, JWT auth and the deployment topology, each with a fresh PNG export.

tasks.title: Write the Sprint 5 retrospective and record the Sprint 6 plan in docs
tasks.description: docs/sprint5-retro.md with Start, Stop, Continue and owned, dated action items; docs/sprint-6-plan.md and .json match the Jira board.

stories.title: SCRUM-94 — User Story 2 (Extra Credit), Playwright E2E Tests in CI (https://streetcarnola.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-94)

tasks.title: Set up Playwright and a CI job that runs it against the full stack
tasks.description: Playwright config and a CI job that starts the backend and frontend and runs the suite on every push; deploy waits on it; report uploaded.

tasks.title: Playwright tests for the student flows
tasks.description: Three E2E tests: student sign-in, sign-up with onboarding, and creating then editing a submission; pass in CI and rerun cleanly.

tasks.title: Playwright tests for the advisor flows
tasks.description: Three E2E tests: advisor sign-in and dashboard, advisor deleting a submission, and a student blocked from delete and /advisor; pass in CI.

stories.title: SCRUM-95 — User Story 3 (Extra Credit), Mobile Deployment (https://streetcarnola.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-95)

tasks.title: Scaffold the Expo app with sign-in against the live backend
tasks.description: Expo app in mobile/ that signs in against the live backend, stores the JWT in SecureStore and routes by role in Expo Go.

tasks.title: Mobile student screens: recommendations and submissions
tasks.description: Student recommendations and submissions screens on the live API; a submission created on the phone appears in the web app.

tasks.title: Mobile advisor screen, sign-out on 401, and Expo Go demo instructions
tasks.description: Advisor dashboard screen, sign-out on 401, and README instructions with a QR code for opening the app in Expo Go.

stories.title: SCRUM-96 — User Story 4 (Extra Credit), Advisors work from real student, alumni and appointment records (https://streetcarnola.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-96)

tasks.title: Decide the additional feature and get instructor approval
tasks.description: Feature chosen Nov 17: advisors look up any student and see real alumni, appointments and conversations; the story and its tasks were rewritten with that scope.

tasks.title: Backend: alumni, appointments and conversations tables with advisor and account endpoints
tasks.description: student_profiles, alumni_profiles, appointments and conversations tables with foreign keys to users and JPA relationships; advisor-only /advisor/students, /advisor/appointments and /advisor/alumni plus GET /account; students get 403 and missing tokens 401; coverage stays 70%+.

tasks.title: Frontend: My Students, Appointments, Alumni Database and My Account pages, plus alumni sign-in
tasks.description: Advisor sidebar items become real pages showing live Supabase data, a My Account page for every role and an alumni sign-in card; each page has Vitest render and interaction tests.

stories.title: SCRUM-106 — User Story 5 (Extra Credit), Google Sign-In via Supabase (https://streetcarnola.atlassian.net/browse/SCRUM-106)

tasks.title: Configure Google OAuth and Supabase Auth
tasks.description: Google OAuth client and Supabase Google provider with live and local redirect URLs; asymmetric JWT signing keys so the JWKS URL lists a key; Supabase keys set on Render, never committed.

tasks.title: Verify every request against Supabase's JWKS, with roles in a Profile table
tasks.description: spring-boot-starter-oauth2-resource-server checks every token against Supabase's JWKS; roles come from a users/Profile row keyed by sub, created on first sight; GET /auth/me returns the role; bad tokens get 401, students get 403 on delete.

tasks.title: Proxy email/password sign-up and sign-in to Supabase Auth
tasks.description: Backend forwards /auth/signup and /auth/login to Supabase Auth and returns Supabase's access token, so email/password and Google share one JWKS check; BCrypt removed; demo accounts seeded in Supabase.

tasks.title: Frontend Google sign-in, redirect handling, and role from /auth/me
tasks.description: Continue with Google does a real browser redirect to Supabase; the callback clears the token from the URL and signs in; the role comes from GET /auth/me; Vitest tests pass.
